text: しょうぶで　けいけんを　つむと　もらえます。

structure.jp: しょうぶで　けいけんを　つむと
structure.en: when you gain experience in battles

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says 'whenever this happens, that follows'. けいけんを　つむと = 'when you build up experience'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing もらう to もらえる gives 'can receive'. もらえます = 'you can get them'.
